recipe.visualDefinition: A central, T-shaped stack of weathered black industrial speakers against a desaturated white background with a cyan-to-white vertical gradient. The speakers feature red and white diagonal hazard tape accents and a single thin black wire trailing off to the left.
coreVisualRelationships: T-shaped central monolith against a vast negative space
Cyan gradient header contrasting with a warm-white floor
Industrial grit of the speakers versus the clean, flat typography
Hazard tape providing the only high-saturation color accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left text, moves across to the top-right text, then drops down to the central speaker monolith.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive, creating a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for the speaker cabinets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan for the sky-like gradient; Red and White for the hazard tape.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value background and low-value central subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all display elements to maintain industrial uniformity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature.
Provides the specific ultra-condensed industrial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A minimalist studio shot of a T-shaped stack of three black industrial speakers. The top two are horizontal, the bottom one is vertical. Add red and white diagonal hazard tape to the speaker faces. The background is a vast, empty white room with a soft cyan gradient at the very top. A single black wire trails from the speakers to the bottom left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. The text should be a muted slate-grey color, set in Title Case with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a cyan-to-white gradient?
Is the text extra-condensed and placed in the top corners?
Are there red/white hazard stripes on the speakers?

adjustableVariables: Amount of weathering on the speakers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the cyan gradient.
Check that the speaker stack looks physically grounded.
Verify the hazard tape has a diagonal 45-degree pattern.
Confirm the trailing wire is thin and organic in its curve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central industrial object + massive negative space + corner-aligned condensed typography + two-tone gradient background.
